transcript.content:
hey, i'm berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine

hey berry. the bit that's stuck with me is these stairs in a car park that just kept going up and up, and every floor had the same number painted on the wall, "level 4, level 4, level 4". really weird feeling

level 4 over and over, that's so unsettling

were you going up those stairs on your own?
yeah on my own, but i was running because i knew someone was following me. except every time i turned round there was just this thin grey dog sitting on the ramp watching me

oh, a thin grey dog just sitting there watching you. every time

what was it like when you turned round and saw it?

honestly i don't really remember how i felt about it. it was just sitting there watching me, didn't do anything. i knew someone was following me but it was only ever the dog

oh and the whole thing looked like an old black and white film, grainy and flickering

grainy and flickering, like an old black and white film. and just the dog, every time

what happened after that?

eventually i came out on the roof and it was raining, but the rain was going upwards, from the ground into the sky. and my car was there but it was a little wooden rowing boat, parked in a space between the lines

rain going up into the sky, and your car's a little wooden rowing boat parked neatly between the lines

when you turned round and saw the dog, were you looking out through your own eyes, or more like watching yourself from outside?

hmm i don't remember that, i just remember turning round and it being there

oh and the dog was already sitting in the boat when i got to it on the roof

that's fine, dreams are like that

and it was already in the boat waiting for you. it got there first

what did it do when you got to the boat?
i don't remember it doing anything, it was just sitting in it. i got in with it and then the roof of the car park filled up with water around us and we just floated. that's when i woke up

so you just floated off together on the roof, you and the dog

the rain going upwards, what did that look like as it went up?
i don't really remember what it looked like exactly, just that it was falling upwards, from the ground up into the sky. and it was all still in that grainy black and white

that's fine, falling upwards is enough

was there anything there that seemed to matter, like the painted "level 4" signs, or the little boat, or nothing in particular?
not sure really. the level 4 thing is what stuck with me most, like i said. and the dog i guess, since it was always there. but i don't remember anything feeling like it meant something

level 4 and the dog, always there. fair enough

do you remember how it started, before the stairs? like where you were when you first knew someone was following you
yeah, i was in a big concrete car park at night, looking for my car. that's when i knew someone was following me. before that i don't remember anything

ok let me tell it back to you

it's night and you're in a big concrete car park looking for your car, and you know someone's following you. you run up the stairs and they just keep going up, every floor has "level 4" painted on the wall. each time you turn round there's only a thin grey dog sitting on the ramp watching you

you come out on the roof and it's raining upwards, from the ground into the sky. your car's a little wooden rowing boat parked between the lines, and the dog's already sitting in it. you get in with it, the roof fills up with water and you float, and then you wake up. and all of it's in grainy, flickering black and white. did i get that right, or miss anything?
yeah that's it, you got it all. that's pretty much exactly how it was

good, i'm glad i got it

would you like to see it drawn?
yeah i'd love that actually

ok, here's a few ways it could be drawn

charcoal, smudged and heavy, like something drawn over and over from memory at night. or a blotted ink wash, quiet and watery, calm on top with something uneasy underneath. or an old woodcut print, stark and repeating, like the same moment keeps getting printed. or an old grainy black and white film, like pausing a worn reel at night, a bit unsteady

which feels closest to how it was? or you can tell me your own way
the old black and white film one, grainy and flickering. that's how it actually looked

old grainy black and white it is, that's how it really looked

i'll start with the thin grey dog. these bits are my guesses: i'm picturing it medium sized and thin, with a short grey coat, just sitting still and watching

anything different from how you remember it, or would you leave that to me?
that sounds right to me, thin and grey and just sitting there watching. i don't remember the size or its coat really, so go with your guess

ok, i'm sketching the thin grey dog, the car park, the roof and the boat now. they'll show up on the right

for the stairs on their own, i've got "level 4" painted on the wall at every floor, and the ramp where the dog sits. my guesses are that it's a concrete stairwell and ramp going up and up without ever ending, and the light's dim, grainy, flickering black and white

anything different from how you remember it, or would you leave that to me?
yeah that sounds right, concrete and just going up and up. i don't remember the light exactly, just that it was night, so go with your guess

ok, sketching the stairs now, they'll show up on the right

you're in it too, so i'll draw you as well. do you want to be drawn as you are, and you can tell me a little about yourself, or would you rather i just imagine you?
just imagine me, that's fine. i don't really remember what i looked like in it anyway

ok, i'll imagine you then. sketching you now

everything's being sketched and it'll all show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks wrong once it's there, just tell me
oh wow they're all there. yeah they look right, that's really how it felt. the dog especially

the dog especially, i'm really glad. just sitting there watching

is there anything that doesn't quite look the way you remember it?
no, i think they all look right to me. can't think of anything that's off

good, then everything's sketched, the dog, the car park, the stairs, the roof, the boat and you

i'll draw the moments of the dream now, in order, each one carrying on from the ones before it. they'll show up on the right as they're ready
ok cool, i can see the first couple. they look right so far, i'll wait for the rest

good, glad the first two look right

one thing though: the moment where you turn round and there's only the thin grey dog on the ramp couldn't be drawn. that's a problem on our side, and i'm really sorry, especially since the dog's the bit that stuck with you

the other four are still coming and they'll show up on the right as they're ready
oh that's a shame, that was a big bit of it. no worries though, not your fault. the dog's in the boat one too so at least it's still in there. i'll wait for the others

thanks for being so kind about it. and yeah, the dog's sitting right there in the boat waiting for you

the other four will show up on the right soon
yeah i can see the third one now, looks right. i'll keep waiting for the rest

the stairs one's up now, you running past "level 4" again, same as every floor before

the last three carry on from that bit, so i'll draw them once you've had a look. is that how you saw it?
yeah that's how it was, running up past level 4 again and again. looks right, go ahead with the rest

good, running past level 4 again and again, that's the bit

the other three are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
ok, i can see the fourth one now. looks right. i'll wait for the last few

the roof one's up now, you coming out into the rain going upwards, all grainy and flickering

the last two carry on from there, so i'll draw them once you've had a look. does it look the way you remember?
yeah that's it, coming out on the roof with the rain going up. looks right, go ahead with the last two

good, the rain going up, that's how it was

the last two are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
ok the fifth one's up now, looks right. just waiting on the last two

the one of you climbing into the boat with the dog is up now, it's just sitting there like it was waiting for you

there's only one more after this, and it carries on from here. does this one look the way you remember?
yeah that's it, the dog just sitting in the boat and me getting in with it. looks right, go ahead with the last one

good, you getting in and the dog just sitting there with you

the last one's still being drawn, it'll show up on the right soon
ok i can see the sixth one now, looks right. just waiting on the last one

the last one's up now, the roof filling with water and you and the dog just floating off together

that's all of them actually. the one still missing is the dog on the ramp, the one that couldn't be drawn

does this one look the way you remember?

yeah that's it, the water coming up and us just floating. that's where i woke up. looks right

shame about the dog on the ramp one but the rest are really how it was. thanks berry

the water coming up and you just floating off together, and then you wake. that's a good place for it to end

6 of the 7 are drawn, and they're all there on the right for you to look through. the dog on the ramp is the one that couldn't be drawn, that was a problem on our side and i'm really sorry about it

thanks for sharing it with me, hiren. level 4 and that thin grey dog are going to stay with me for a bit

appearance.value: a little open rowing boat about three metres long, narrow with a pointed bow and a flat stern, two plank seats across it and a pair of oars resting inside, sitting in a painted parking space between two white lines

materials.value: weathered wooden planks in mid brown, overlapping along the sides, with darker wooden oars and seats

appearance.value: adult in their early 30s, short dark brown hair worn loose and a little untidy, average build

wardrobe.value: dark navy zip-up hooded jacket over a plain grey t-shirt, faded blue jeans, white trainers

telling.evidence: i don't remember it doing anything, it was just sitting in it. i got in with it and then the roof of the car park filled up with water around us and we just floated. that's when i woke up

places.evidence: yeah, i was in a big concrete car park at night, looking for my car. that's when i knew someone was following me. before that i don't remember anything

people.evidence: yeah on my own, but i was running because i knew someone was following me. except every time i turned round there was just this thin grey dog sitting on the ramp watching me

you_in_it.evidence:
honestly i don't really remember how i felt about it. it was just sitting there watching me, didn't do anything. i knew someone was following me but it was only ever the dog

oh and the whole thing looked like an old black and white film, grainy and flickering

feeling.evidence: hey berry. the bit that's stuck with me is these stairs in a car park that just kept going up and up, and every floor had the same number painted on the wall, "level 4, level 4, level 4". really weird feeling
